def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]

    # The object in the first compartment is repeated in every compartment.
    r0, r1 = 0, sep_rows[0] if sep_rows else h
    c0, c1 = 0, sep_cols[0] if sep_cols else w
    pattern = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0, r1)
               for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] not in (3, 8)]

    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in sep_rows]
    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep_cols]
    for rs in row_starts:
        for cs in col_starts:
            if rs == 0 and cs == 0:
                continue
            for r, c, color in pattern:
                rr, cc = rs + r, cs + c
                if rr < h and cc < w and grid[rr][cc] != 8:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                and grid[0][c] != bg]

    row_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Copy the non-background marks in the first compartment to each other compartment.
    r_start, c_start = row_edges[0] + 1, col_edges[0] + 1
    r_end, c_end = row_edges[1], col_edges[1]
    marks = [(r - r_start, c - c_start, grid[r][c])
             for r in range(r_start, r_end)
             for c in range(c_start, c_end)
             if grid[r][c] != bg]

    for i in range(len(row_edges) - 1):
        for j in range(len(col_edges) - 1):
            if i == 0 and j == 0:
                continue
            rs, cs = row_edges[i] + 1, col_edges[j] + 1
            re, ce = row_edges[i + 1], col_edges[j + 1]
            for dr, dc, color in marks:
                rr, cc = rs + dr, cs + dc
                if rr < re and cc < ce:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
